entries.headline: Baseline: certifications reshuffled, MCP went stateless, and AI supply-chain risk became real

items.title: AWS GenAI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01) is the flagship AWS AI credential
items.summary: Out of beta since March 2026; USD 300. ML Specialty retired on 31 March 2026.

items.title: AWS AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01) in beta at USD 50
items.summary: Business-judgement exam on AI investment, governance and scaling; early-adopter badge if passed by 15 Feb 2027.

items.title: AWS microcredentials are free
items.summary: Includes Agentic AI Demonstrated and Securing Agent Identities Demonstrated; no Skill Builder subscription needed.

items.title: Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base is GA
items.summary: Managed RAG with hybrid search, reranking and an agentic retriever; plugs into AgentCore Gateway.

items.title: MCP 2026-07-28: stateless core
items.summary: No session handshake; any request can hit any server instance. Build new MCP servers on this spec.

items.title: LiteLLM compromised on PyPI twice in 2026
items.summary: March (1.82.7, 1.82.8) and October (1.107.0 plus Docker images). Treat AI gateways as crown-jewel services.

entries.careerAction: This week: start the free AWS Agentic AI Demonstrated microcredential and decide whether to book the AIB-C01 beta.
